title: Known-object test, TOI-2423.01
summary: Known-object test on TOI-2423.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Residual screen: 190 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 5 light curve(s), forming 69 distinct event(s), 8 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines.
